name: Fujigaoka Ayame
source:
[url=/c166985]Hibana[/url]'s best and childhood friend who lives nearby. After hearing that [url=/c167744]Hajime[/url] made Hibana one of his maids, they start arguing about various things. Ayame sees herself as a perfectly normal girl, when in reality the fact that she's Hibana's best friend leads to Ayame seeming a bit odd as well.

Because of her very caring nature, [url=/c166990]Ichika[/url] quickly becomes attached to her... but unfortunately, at the same time, Hajime keeps htting on her because he finds her cute and  the fact that she hates him eggs him on.

[From [url=https://asa-pro.com/ousama/character/]official website[/url]]
